title: Decay-Region Group Delay as a Forensic Cue for AI-Generated Impulsive Sounds
abstract: arXiv:2608.26346v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate whether AI-generated impulsive sounds can be distinguished from real ones through group delay analysis. Our central finding is that AI-generated impulsive sounds show near-identical onset-region group-delay distributions but exhibit measurably different group-delay behavior in the late decay region: decay-region KL divergence reaches $0.322$ compared to near-zero onset divergence ($0.022$). Cross-band GD variability achieves single-feature AUC~=~0.720, and a Random Forest (RF) over nine decay-region features reaches AUC~$=$~0.884 under sample-disjoint evaluation. A group delay map used as a standalone 2D input to CNN classifiers achieves 90--94\% accuracy, demonstrating that group delay carries substantial discriminative information. translated_title: 衰减区域群延迟作为AI生成脉冲声音的取证线索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26346v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们研究了是否可以通过群延迟分析区分AI生成的脉冲声音与真实声音。我们的核心发现是，AI生成的脉冲声音在起始区域的群延迟分布几乎相同，但在后期衰减区域表现出可测量的群延迟差异：衰减区域的KL散度达到0.322，而起始区域散度接近零（0.022）。跨频带群延迟变异性实现了单特征AUC=0.720，而基于九个衰减区域特征的随机森林在样本分离评估下达到AUC=0.884。将群延迟图作为独立2D输入用于CNN分类器，实现了90-94%的准确率，表明群延迟携带大量判别性信息。在生成器留出测试下，CNN和Transformer分类器表现出高度可变的AUC（0.457-0.918）。群延迟随机森林在评估方法中实现了最高的平均留出准确率。
tldr: 该论文发现AI生成的脉冲声音在衰减区域的群延迟特征与真实声音存在显著差异，并利用这一线索构建了高精度的取证分类器。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that AI-generated impulsive sounds exhibit measurable group-delay differences in the decay region compared to real sounds, and leverages this cue to build high-accuracy forensic classifiers.
